description: Transient Simulation Dataset for Power Regulation of Mobile Gas-Cooled Micro-Reactor Gas Turbine Power Generation System 移动式气冷微堆燃气轮机发电系统功率调节瞬态仿真数据集 is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors yang yi hao (Xi'an Jiaotong University). This dataset contains key transient response data of a mobile gas cooled micro reactor gas turbine power generation system during variable load regulation. The data was generated through simulation using the Gas Turbine Microreactor Transient Analysis Program (GTM-TAP) independently developed by the author. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 48756 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
